title: account.suspended v1 payload
description: Identity suspended an account and revoked its sessions and refresh tokens (8.4, 8.6). subject_id is the account; actor_id is the staff member (null for the system). No reason text: it stays in identity. Consumers hide what the account owns until account.unsuspended (8.5).

until.description: When the suspension lifts by itself; null until staff lift it.
